textures: PBR, four 4K, two 2K and one 1K texture sets

specs.label: Use
specs.value: Enemy or boss for horror and survival games, gameplay and cutscenes

desc:
Zombie-2 has been dead a lot longer: a gaunt, leathery body with skin shrunk tight over the bones, an open torso, white hair still tied back in a bun, and the cargo pants and boots of whoever this used to be. Where Zombie-1 is fresh, this one is dried out, and together they show the range a horde needs.

At 120K tris there's room for the hard parts: tendons and ribs pushing through dry skin, exposed tissue in the stomach, and hair cards for the long white hair. The same texture setup as Zombie-1 (four 4K, two 2K and one 1K sets) carries the cracked skin and stained fabric, and the high-to-low bake keeps the fine detail at game resolution.

Need a range of enemies that each tell their own story? We'll build yours to your style, budget and platform.
